issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares and implements public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch between the UML and the solution/template guidance will confuse students about whether to implement the method to return String or int and may cause tests or expected behaviour to diverge.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and update any textual hints that reference the UML. Alternatively, if the intended return type is String, change the solution and template to implement getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning String and update its implementation and tests accordingly. Ensure the problem text and UML explicitly state the chosen return type to avoid student confusion.
